import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);expect_aux=sys.argv[2]=='1'

import sqlite_runtime as runtime
import sqlite_vector_store as vectors
import index_state_store as state
index=root/'.wavefoundry/index'
conn=runtime.connect(index/'index-state.sqlite',read_only=True)
try:

finally: conn.close()
fts={layer:state.fts_state_verdict(index,layer) for layer in ('docs','code')}

print(json.dumps({'schema':'7','epoch':epoch,'integrity':integrity,'fts':fts,'auxiliary_preserved':expect_aux}))
